wikipulse-desc: Shows every edit on every Wikimedia wiki, live, at [[Special:WikiPulse]].
wikipulse-subtitle: Every bubble is a real edit, made by a real person somewhere in the world, right now.
wikipulse-footnote: Data: Wikimedia [https://stream.wikimedia.org/v2/ui/#/?streams=mediawiki.recentchange EventStreams]. The same RecentChanges data you saw in the API, pushed to your browser the moment it happens.
